'''Karlist Perzam''' is a state named in the Istragarde source and shown on the 2003 and 2022 reference maps.

== Istragarde-Era Crisis ==

Karlist Perzam is most important in the 1994-back draft set because of the 1971 [[Invasion of Batravalka]]. Its leaders invoked the [[Treaty of the Concord of Istragarde]], historical claims, and protection of Perzamic communities to justify the surprise invasion of mineral-rich highlands.

== Legacy ==

The invasion became a precedent for later treaty abuse. The Istragarde system condemned the action but did not organize a military response, showing that formal border rules could be ignored by determined states. Later Volgastani policy followed a similar legal pattern through the [[Volgastani Expansionist Doctrine]].

== Source Limits ==

This draft does not settle Perzam's full government type, capital, founding date, or borders. It preserves the state as needed for the Istragarde failure timeline.
